The '''S19 astromech droid''' was a [[Astromech droid/Legends|droid]] designed by [[LesTech]] to attempt a foray into the lucrative astromech market.

==Characteristics==
The S19 was built on a boxy chassis, much like the [[EG-6 power droid/Legends|EG-6 power droid]]. It moved on a wide, single track that could cause it to be unstable and prone to tipping over during quick maneuvers. It had a claw appendage, six tool appendages, a five-jump [[astrogation buffer]], internal [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a [[Holorecorder/Legends|holorecorder]]. It cost 8625 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] new.<ref name="sgd" /> The S19 could be modified for several different purposes. By reinforcing the droid, gutting the internals, and installing a small [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well generator]] it could be used to prevent enemies from clear shots. It worked much like the [[dovin basal]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="sgd" />

A S19 could become a mobile shield generator by removing the astrogation buffer and holorecorder and installing a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. It would then provide protection for a small group of people. A S19 was able to be modified to act as a trailblazer and scout by removing the track and installing a repulsorlift unit. It needed to be reprogrammed to deal with terrain instead of hyperspace jumps.<ref name="sgd" />
